alex: Quick question — we're sizing Dedicated pools for tenant isolation w/ spot fallback. Can we do per-tenant GPU entitlements (hard reserve) + a shared spot mix on the same cluster? :thinking:
priya: You mean like 2 reserved A100s per tenant + a spot-backed pool for burst? Should be possible but depends on vendor quota and our scheduler config.
samir: We currently support per-tenant reservations in the orchestration layer (resource-classes). Spot mixing is a separate capacity class. Main caveat: preemptible eviction policy can force cross-tenant fallback if not isolated at the tenancy level.
elaine: Who's the vendor contact for asking about per-tenant quotas? I can ping if there's any hard limits on mixing reserved + preemptible GPUs.
alex: @elaine that would be great. Also, curious about quota granularity: can vendor allocate by project/account-level quotas (so we can map to tenant IDs) or only by billing account?
vendor-bot: vendor-reply: We can set quotas per-project and create a shared preemptible pool. However, quotas for reserved devices require a separate order and minimum term. Will send specifics.
priya: Thanks — if vendor can do per-project quota that solves most of it. We'll need terraform + IAM mapping to ensure tenants can't consume each others' reserved tokens.
samir: For the infra side, plan is: 1) create resource-class `reserved-a100-tenant` with hard limit; 2) `spot-a100-shared` for burst; 3) configure scheduler to prefer reserved, fallback to spot only if tenant policy allows.
elaine: Sounds good. alex, can you post the minimal terraform snippet we expect the vendor to accept (so they can validate)?
alex: sure — here's a sample we intend to send: 
```hcl
resource "vendor_gpu_quota" "tenant_reserved" {
  project = "redwood-tenant-<<TENANT_ID>>"
  gpu_type = "A100"
  reserved_count = 2
  term = "monthly"
}
resource "vendor_gpu_pool" "spot_shared" {
  project = "infra-shared"
  gpu_type = "A100"
  preemptible = true
  target_count = 10
}
```
alex: vendor-bot, can you confirm that format is ok or do they need CSV/order form?
vendor-bot: vendor-reply: HCL ok for reference. We will still need a signed order for reserved devices and a project-level quota change request for spots. Expect ~5 business days for quotas and 10 business days for reserved procurement.
priya: timeline noted. Can we start tests with small dummy tenant to validate scheduler behavior before full procurement?
samir: Yes — we can spin up a dev tenant using ephemerals (local GPU pool) and test policy enforcement. I'll create a canary runbook.
elaine: I'll follow up w/ vendor and loop in procurement. alex — can you add the HCL to the ticket for tracking?
alex: done — created ticket INFRA-8123 with snippet + vendor contact. Marking this thread resolved for now. :white_check_mark:
